contentPattern.structure: avatar image + author name (heading) + role + social links

suitableFor: author / contributor credit at the end of an article
byline cards with avatar, name, role and social links
any 'about the author' block with a photo and social handles
notSuitableFor: grids of multiple contributor profiles (use cards)
standalone social-link clusters unrelated to a person
hero/banner style author intros with large background images

socialLinks.reason: The Facebook/Twitter/Instagram cluster appears only inside this author credit within article scope, so social-links is NOT a standalone block; the links are decorated inside article-author.

usage.note: New custom block (no vanilla base). Models the end-of-article author credit: avatar + name + role + inline social links.
